<reason>CON won a competitive debate by making the motion easier to decide: PRO kept the magnets, admitted Saturday may stay fully booked, and never showed most tourism leaving overloaded districts. CON’s demand-composition claim (off-peak recruits already-flexible travelers, not peak families) and addition/export story beat PRO’s substitution-plus-safeguards case, even though crowding costs and hub rationing remained live.</reason>
